name: HAL9000 Networking
summary: Early SA dialup + hosting ISP (site from Dec 1996); defunct.

events.details: Dialup, web hosting. Owned and operated by Mike Bruins (Adelaide), per its own site; also t/a Web Impact.

Defunct. HAL9000-branded content last seen Feb 2012; server default pages from Feb 2013, so death is fixed to by 2013 rather than the proposal's by 2012 (and far from the current c. 2001). own site gone; default server pages thereafter.

refs.label: 2007: domain still served its own HAL9000-branded homepage.
Feb 2012 (20120221110944): STILL the HAL9000-branded splash - rebuts prior claim of a default Apache page by 2012.
By 28 Feb 2013 only a default Apache page; 2014-2019 captures are a bare '(DEFAULT) user1.hal9000.net.au' placeholder and 2025-26 captures just print the hostna
1996 homepage shows the trading styles (HAL9000 Networking Services / Web Impact), all personal-scale; site later became Bruins' personal domain (mrtg/blog).
